rules_deployed_and_enabled.title: Detection Rules Deployed and Enabled
rules_deployed_and_enabled.description: Indicates whether SIEM correlation rules are actively deployed and enabled in the production environment, not merely imported or staged.

false_positive_rate_percent.title: False Positive Rate (Percent)
false_positive_rate_percent.description: The measured percentage of alerts generated by SIEM correlation rules that are false positives over the last 30 days.

rule_tuning_status.title: Rule Tuning and Environment Customization Status
rule_tuning_status.description: Indicates whether SIEM rules have been tuned to the specific environment to reduce noise, including allowlisting of known-good activity and adjustment of thresholds. Also reflects behavioral deviation alert tuning where applicable.

last_rule_review_days_ago.title: Days Since Last Rule Review
last_rule_review_days_ago.description: Number of days elapsed since the SIEM correlation rule set was last reviewed and updated to reflect current threat landscape and environment changes.

baseline_modeling_enabled.title: Behavioral Baseline Modeling Enabled
baseline_modeling_enabled.description: Indicates whether the SIEM or UEBA solution is actively computing statistical behavioral baselines for users, hosts, or entities.

deviation_detection_rules_count.title: Active Deviation Detection Rules Count
deviation_detection_rules_count.description: The number of active correlation rules or analytic models configured to alert on deviations from established behavioral baselines.

baseline_coverage_scope.title: Baseline Coverage Scope
baseline_coverage_scope.description: The breadth of entity types covered by behavioral baseline modeling within the SIEM or UEBA solution.

log_source_types_integrated.title: Integrated Log Source Types
log_source_types_integrated.description: List of distinct log source categories ingested by the SIEM (e.g., endpoint, network, application, cloud, identity).

cross_source_correlation_rules_enabled.title: Cross-Source Correlation Rules Enabled
cross_source_correlation_rules_enabled.description: Whether the SIEM has active correlation rules that join events from two or more distinct log source types to construct attack chains.

active_cross_source_rule_count.title: Active Cross-Source Correlation Rule Count
active_cross_source_rule_count.description: Number of currently enabled correlation rules that span two or more distinct log source types.

alert_output_configured.title: Alert Output/Response Action Configured
alert_output_configured.description: Whether correlation rule matches are configured to produce actionable output such as alerts, tickets, or SOAR triggers.

severity_scoring_enabled.title: Severity Scoring Enabled
severity_scoring_enabled.description: Indicates whether the SIEM is configured to assign structured severity scores (e.g., critical/high/medium/low or numeric) to generated alerts based on defined logic.

alert_prioritization_workflow_configured.title: Alert Prioritization Workflow Configured
alert_prioritization_workflow_configured.description: Indicates whether an analyst workflow (e.g., queue sorting, dashboard views, ticketing integration) is configured to surface highest-severity alerts first.

severity_levels_defined.title: Severity Levels Defined
severity_levels_defined.description: The granularity of severity classification tiers defined within the SIEM correlation rules.

coverage_percentage_of_rules_with_severi.title: Percentage of Correlation Rules with Severity Assigned
coverage_percentage_of_rules_with_severi.description: The percentage of active SIEM correlation rules that have an explicit severity score assigned rather than relying on defaults or having no value.

automated_response_actions_enabled.title: Automated Response Actions Enabled
automated_response_actions_enabled.description: Indicates whether the SIEM or SOAR platform has automated response actions (e.g., account lockout, firewall rule push, ticket creation) configured and active upon rule match.

response_action_types.title: Configured Response Action Types
response_action_types.description: List of automated response action categories configured in the platform (e.g., 'account_lockout', 'firewall_block', 'ticket_creation', 'endpoint_isolation').

rules_with_response_coverage_pct.title: Percentage of Active Rules with Response Coverage
rules_with_response_coverage_pct.description: The percentage of active SIEM/SOAR detection rules that have at least one automated response action bound to them.

active_detection_rule_count.title: Active Detection Rule Count
active_detection_rule_count.description: Total number of currently active/enabled SIEM correlation and detection rules.

mitre_attack_tactic_coverage_count.title: MITRE ATT&CK Tactic Coverage Count
mitre_attack_tactic_coverage_count.description: Number of distinct MITRE ATT&CK tactics covered by at least one active detection rule.

rules_reviewed_within_90_days.title: Detection Rules Reviewed Within 90 Days
rules_reviewed_within_90_days.description: Indicates whether the active detection rule set has been reviewed and validated within the past 90 days to confirm rules are current and effective.

critical_sources_onboarded.title: Critical Log Sources Onboarded
critical_sources_onboarded.description: Indicates whether all critical log sources (e.g., firewalls, domain controllers, endpoint agents, cloud services) are configured and sending logs to the SIEM.

log_feed_health_percent.title: Log Feed Health Percentage
log_feed_health_percent.description: Percentage of configured log sources currently actively streaming data to the SIEM within the expected polling interval.

stale_or_silent_source_count.title: Stale or Silent Source Count
stale_or_silent_source_count.description: Number of configured log sources that have not sent any data within the expected ingestion window, indicating a potential gap in coverage.

rule_version_control_enabled.title: Detection Rule Version Control Enabled
rule_version_control_enabled.description: Indicates whether SIEM detection rules are stored and managed in a version control system (e.g., Git), enabling change tracking, rollback, and audit history.

rule_review_cycle_days.title: Maximum Days Between Rule Review Cycles
rule_review_cycle_days.description: The maximum number of days between scheduled reviews of active detection rules to assess efficacy, false positive rates, and relevance.

rule_testing_process.title: Detection Rule Testing Process Maturity
rule_testing_process.description: Describes the maturity level of the process used to test detection rules before deployment and after tuning changes.

deprecated_rules_removed.title: Deprecated Rules Removed from Active Rulesets
deprecated_rules_removed.description: Indicates whether obsolete or deprecated detection rules have been formally removed or disabled from the active SIEM ruleset, preventing alert noise and rule sprawl.

threat_intel_feeds_enabled.title: Threat Intelligence Feeds Enabled
threat_intel_feeds_enabled.description: Indicates whether threat intelligence feed ingestion is actively enabled and configured in the SIEM.

active_feed_count.title: Active Threat Intelligence Feed Count
active_feed_count.description: Number of threat intelligence feeds currently active and ingesting IOC data (IPs, hashes, domains) into the SIEM.

ioc_correlation_rules_status.title: IOC Correlation Rules Status
ioc_correlation_rules_status.description: Status of SIEM correlation rules that actively match log events against ingested IOC data.

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days historical logs are retained in indexed storage, enabling forensic analysis and compliance evidence preservation.

forensic_query_capability_enabled.title: Forensic Query Capability Enabled
forensic_query_capability_enabled.description: Whether the SIEM or log management platform provides an active, functioning query interface for searching historical log data.

log_indexing_status.title: Log Indexing Status
log_indexing_status.description: Current status of log indexing pipeline, indicating whether logs ingested into the platform are being indexed for queryability.
